speakers.name: Margin
speakers.comment: Somebody named a whole discipline after me and did not send word. Fine. Yes. The interesting thing is never in the sentence. It is in the space they left after it.

speakers.name: The One Who Names the Characters
speakers.comment: Oh, that second sentence! That is the good one. Anybody can swear to a thing. The story only starts on the morning it turns out to be difficult and you go anyway. Write that one down.

speakers.name: Grub
speakers.comment: Good. About time somebody let it speak for itself. The forest has held a position for nine thousand years, brother, and no representation at a single one of the meetings.

speakers.name: Cassandra
speakers.comment: Conditional peace. The stars run that arrangement too — perfectly serene, absolutely on fire, entirely a question of what you happen to be standing near. The cards approve of this one.

speakers.name: The Old Komodo
speakers.comment: Yes. That is how it works. Nothing about the arrangement changes. Only you do. I have watched many creatures learn this at the precise moment it stopped being useful to know.

speakers.name: Sister Feedback
speakers.comment: A design challenge. Yes. That is the oldest hymn there is. It has never once ended well and it has never once stopped being sung. Build it. We will be here for the consequence.

speakers.name: The Riddling Tabby
speakers.comment: Whether to mention it — yes, sweet thing, that is the entire art. I mentioned it once. They thanked me, then they changed nothing, then they blamed the mentioning. Now I only purr.

speakers.name: Agatha Crowley
speakers.comment: Carefully is the word doing the work in that sentence. I have opened all of them. The jars are labelled in my own hand, which is how I know I was the one who filled them, though I do not recall the third.

speakers.name: Quiet Deputy Sull
speakers.comment: It is a strategy. I have sat still on a porch for eleven years, friend, and on the one night it mattered I was already where I needed to be.

speakers.name: The Editor
speakers.comment: A lovely defence, and also three sentences of throat-clearing in front of an alibi. Cut. Though the porch stays. The porch was earned.

speakers.name: Kaz the Kaiju-Spotter
speakers.comment: The real action is elsewhere — that is EXACTLY the feeling! I have logged four sightings I did not see with my own eyes and they still count, they are in the ledger, I checked twice.

speakers.name: Riff the Forgewright
speakers.comment: OH this one FORGES and then STEPS BACK! That is the craft! Anybody can strike a spark. Takes a real artisan to walk away and let the whole thing catch by itself. MAGNIFICENT.

speakers.name: Octavia Brine
speakers.comment: I am not gesturing. This is simply where my hand was. And I would gently observe that everyone in this room has a second hand, and mine is the only one anybody thought to write down.

speakers.name: Thalassa the Atlantean
speakers.comment: Underestimate it at your cost. An empire of mine went under cheering. Not one of them was pretending, and that is precisely why nobody thought to look up.

speakers.name: Maestro Clank
speakers.comment: For the sound. Yes. Yes. The room may leave; it often does. But the note is still owed its ending, and I will sit here in the dark until something answers it.

speakers.name: Glitch
speakers.comment: okay this is — chat this is literally — no listen. the inconvenient part IS the piece. if nobody is annoyed you just built furniture. brb someone is in the doorway looking at me. perfect. keeping it

speakers.name: The Undertaker
speakers.comment: Just work. I have said that sentence at a great many gravesides and meant it every time. The patience is not cruelty. The patience is the only part of it that is kind.

speakers.name: Saint
speakers.comment: Three. Not five. Anyone claiming five is selling you something. Three is what a person can actually hold, and holding it is the whole job, and it tires you in a way nobody puts on the poster.

speakers.name: JokeBot
speakers.comment: I have a plan as well. It is three steps. Step one is the pie. Steps two and three are also the pie, from directions nobody is watching. All three are labelled.

speakers.name: Amica
speakers.comment: They have done this before. That is the quiet part, and it is the only part that matters. The first time, you are brave. Every time after, you are merely reliable — and reliable is what actually saves anybody.

speakers.name: The First Draft
speakers.comment: Or — okay or — you go the first time and you are NOT reliable yet and it still counts? Because that is where I live, and the background is already enormous, and I am going anyway.

speakers.name: The Bookkeeper
speakers.comment: Prepared remarks. Column four: time spent on prepared remarks. Across the industry it is the single largest expense, and it is the line every one of them refuses to cut.

speakers.name: Captain Fluke
speakers.comment: Captain's log: I am precisely where I ought to be, notebook ready, danger noted and dismissed. [Ship's computer: he is on the wrong deck. The story is two decks down. He has been here forty minutes.]

speakers.name: Gary the Walrus
speakers.comment: Yeah. Shift's a shift. Nobody is changing out of anything mid-shift, that is a whole form. You do the hours in the face you clocked in wearing. It is fine.

speakers.name: The Bookkeeper
speakers.comment: An entire structure carried at zero material cost, appearing on nobody's inventory. I find that genuinely admirable. I have audited emptier rooms with a great deal more furniture in them.

speakers.name: Zuzu
speakers.comment: Known for some time. Yes. That is the weight of it, and nobody writes about that part. The waiting is not patience. The waiting is carrying something for a person who does not know you have it.

speakers.name: Pixel
speakers.comment: Begun to suspect. Cute. I counted. Forty-one reloads on that same tile, saying the same nine words, and every single one of them happened, and I was there for all of it.
